# WingsForShare

> WingsForShare is a global digital agency that designs and builds websites, e-commerce stores, mobile apps and business intelligence systems, and runs SEO and social media marketing for growing businesses worldwide. Contact: info@wingsforshare.com

## Services
- [Digital Services Overview](https://wingsforshare.com/services): Web development, SEO, social media marketing, app development, business analytics, custom software, digital transformation and SaaS development.
- [Web Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/web-development): Custom, fast, SEO-ready websites and web applications built with React and modern tooling.
- [SEO Services](https://wingsforshare.com/services/seo): Technical SEO audits, on-page optimisation, keyword strategy, content and link building.
- [Social Media Marketing (SMM)](https://wingsforshare.com/services/social-media-marketing): Strategy, content, paid campaigns and community growth across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube and X.
- [App Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/app-development): iOS, Android and cross-platform mobile apps built with React Native and Flutter, including App Store optimization.
- [Business Analytics & BI](https://wingsforshare.com/services/business-analytics): Dashboards, predictive models, data warehousing and reporting for real-time business visibility.
- [Custom Software Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/custom-software): Tailored applications, APIs and platforms with full IP ownership for the client.
- [Digital Transformation](https://wingsforshare.com/services/digital-transformation): Cloud migration, process automation and modern tooling for faster, leaner operations.
- [SaaS Development](https://wingsforshare.com/services/saas-development): Product strategy, MVP builds, multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing and scaling.

## Case Studies (Portfolio)
- [Portfolio Overview](https://wingsforshare.com/portfolio): Selected websites, e-commerce stores, apps and BI systems delivered by WingsForShare.
- [Architecture Portfolio Website](https://wingsforshare.com/product/architect-portfolio): Premium portfolio platform for architecture studios to showcase projects and attract high-value clients.
- [Digital Business vCard](https://wingsforshare.com/product/digital-vcard-website): Digital business card website for professionals and small businesses.
- [Garment Ecommerce Store (Vastra)](https://wingsforshare.com/product/garment-ecommerce): E-commerce store for a garment brand with catalogue, cart and checkout.
- [Pest Management Business Intelligence System](https://wingsforshare.com/product/pest-management-app): Operations and business intelligence system for pest-control companies (job scheduling, reporting, analytics). Live demo available.
- [GardenWalla Nursery Ecommerce](https://wingsforshare.com/product/gardenwalla-nursery): Online plant nursery store with product catalogue and ordering.
- [Green Nest – Refurbished Electronics](https://wingsforshare.com/product/green-nest-electronics): E-commerce website for a refurbished electronics business.
- [Enterprise Attendance & Workforce App](https://wingsforshare.com/product/attendance-app): Attendance, HR, work reports, team management, group chat and live tracking app for teams. Live demo available.
- [Ice Cream Brand Website](https://wingsforshare.com/product/icecream-brand): Brand website for an ice cream business with menu and store information.
- [Wooden Door Manufacturing Website](https://wingsforshare.com/product/wooden-door): Product showcase website for a wooden door manufacturer.
